requiredFindings.title: Root-to-H open and present-child open omit the kind-check status read
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A ledger whose remaining edges equal retained_path_open_cost(home).edges admits open_accounted. from_retained_handle calls File::metadata on every retained handle and every temporary recheck handle, 2(N+1) status reads the formula does not include (6 reads for /Users/sb; opening / is priced at 4 edges and performs 6 operations). A present Library adds one more uncounted metadata through open_child_directory_if_present_accounted. recheck_exact_names_cost repeats the short recheck twice. The published-cost test only checks ledger.used() equals that formula, so the walk is recorded as fully charged.

requiredFindings.title: Filesystem observation cost omits the status buffer it says it counts
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Premise admission calls observe_filesystem_accounted on an omitted ancestor such as /. A ledger whose remaining bytes equal descriptor_filesystem_observation_cost().bytes admits the call. observe_filesystem still calls file.metadata() before fstatfs, and bytes is only size_of::<statfs>() plus size_of::<DescriptorFilesystem>(). The status buffer is outside the reservation, once per omitted ancestor admits inspects. The parent tests take this path on / when the test premise is supplied.
